items.title: Cua Driver Bench measures background desktop agents that leave you undisturbed
items.summary: Cua and Scale AI AgentEnv launched Cua Driver Bench for desktop agents that must work in the background without stealing focus. On macOS they report Cua Driver fully passing 58% versus Codex computer use 33%, Vercel agent-desktop 20%, and browser-use 3%, with a write-up, HF space, and dataset.

doubt.pushback: Repliers note it is the vendor's own bench and that Claude computer use was omitted because it is locked to Claude's app.

reception.summary: Builders praise the undisturbed/background focus rule; a few ask about permission dialogs and Claude coverage.

items.title: Meta ships Muse Wonder Active Memory and Active Focus into Muse and Meta AI
items.summary: Meta is rolling specialized Muse Wonder models with Active Memory and Active Focus into Muse and Meta AI. In Muse they report a 2.4x drop in forgetting goal-critical information and a 67% improvement at getting unstuck when constraints change.

items.title: DeepMind human-guided agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
items.summary: DeepMind says human-guided AI agents, with cryptanalysis experts, found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA: cheaper signature forgery paths and a batch-factoring method they estimate about 30x cheaper per extra same-length key. They stress modern 2048-bit RSA is not affected and published two technical papers.

doubt.pushback: Many replies stress 1024-bit RSA was already deprecated; the news is agent-accelerated cryptanalysis, not a break of modern 2048-bit keys.

reception.summary: Repliers and quotes treat it as a research tempo story about guided agents, repeatedly clarifying that RSA-2048 remains safe and that 1024-bit was already obsolete.

items.title: Rapid-MLX 1.0.2 adds local Pika H3 Flex video+audio and Idle Unload on Mac
items.summary: Rapid-MLX 1.0.2 ships local video and audio generation via Pika H3 Flex, stop-generating for video jobs, paste-any Hugging Face link, a smaller 1.6GB first-run path, and Idle Unload that drops idle chat models from RAM while keeping the local API up.

items.title: Reflection publishes Beam model technical report
items.summary: Reflection released the full Beam model technical report covering the methodology used to train Beam end-to-end in-house.

items.title: Antigravity Voice mode lets you steer coding agents out loud via Gemini Live
items.summary: Google Antigravity shipped Voice mode powered by Gemini Live. Users can plan, steer code changes, and approve permissions by voice across languages, interrupt mid-turn, set voice and playback speed, and end with bye or a tap.

items.title: opencode server image lets you run the agent over Docker and connect remote clients
items.summary: opencode maintainer @thdxr showed running the opencode server from a published container image so TUI, desktop, and other clients can connect over a port instead of a local-only process.

items.title: Zyphra beta-releases MAIA, a multiplayer team agent on its fullstack
items.summary: Zyphra opened a free beta of MAIA, described as the application layer of its fullstack: a proactive multiplayer AI agent for teams that can recover prior decisions, people, and sources.

doubt.pushback: Product beta with limited independent confirmation in this window.

items.title: Mistral highlights Voxtral 3 end-of-turn detection for voice agents
items.summary: Mistral showed Voxtral 3 end-of-turn detection that flags when a speaker has finished, aimed at builders of responsive voice agents that should not wait on fixed silence timers alone.

doubt.pushback: Demo post with no docs or API link in the hydrated entities.

items.title: turbopuffer v3 cascading binary search speeds storage lookups up to 1.9x
items.summary: turbopuffer reports up to 1.9x faster storage lookups on tpuf v3 by cascading binary search across the three key columns instead of comparing all three at every step.

items.title: p-jit 21k drops Apache-2.0 2B pixel-space text-to-image weights trained for $21k
items.summary: A two-person team released p-jit 21k, a 2B pixel-space text-to-image model (no VAE) with Apache-2.0 weights and code, trained on about 660M samples and roughly 8415 H100-hours for a reported $21k.

doubt.pushback: Surfaced via an aggregator post; primary account not on roster.

items.title: Cuthol is an open-source local video editor for agents over CLI and MCP
items.summary: Cuthol is an open-source video editor built for AI agents that cut, caption, mix, and render locally through a CLI or MCP, checking edits via text rather than pixels.

doubt.pushback: Very new discovery post with low engagement so far.
